title: Aureline M5 problem-record set
description: Canonical, export-safe object model that freezes the individual M5 Problems-panel row. Each record is a single run-derived finding bound to its source tool/run refs, its file/span anchor, its structured-versus-heuristic parse class, its confidence tier and raw-output backlink, the editor decoration / timeline entry / source task / owning output channel it is correlated with, and the freshness / stale / superseded state of the run it came from. The record carries enough identity to re-derive an effective status and a per-action availability (jump to source, open owning output, rerun or inspect the originating task/session) without trusting a grade: structured and heuristic origins stay distinct, a heuristic parse keeps a raw-output backlink, stale/superseded/downgraded findings stay visibly classified, imported provider findings inspect read-only and never rerun locally, and a finding that loses its source lineage floors to a raw-output backlink rather than rendering a clean-but-false actionable row. This is the per-record companion to schemas/tooling/m5-execution-evidence.schema.json (the lane matrix); both speak one vocabulary so Problems, the editor, output, timeline, review, CLI/headless, AI evidence, and support export ingest one model instead of a private bottom-panel truth model. Adding an enum value is additive-minor and requires a schema_version bump; repurposing an existing value is breaking and requires a new decision row.

redaction_class_token.description: Default redaction posture for the packet. No raw stdout/stderr bytes, command lines, provider log bodies, env bodies, absolute paths, URLs, or secrets ever cross this boundary; anchors carry an opaque file ref plus line/column numbers only.

claim_posture.description: Whether the row is publicly claimed. Labs/unadvertised rows make no actionability claim and are never widened.

origin_class.description: How the run/evidence originated. First-party local/notebook/headless/extension/AI origins can be fully actionable; remote, pipeline/provider, and imported origins are read-only and never offer a live local rerun.

problem_source_kind.description: Whether the finding came from a native structured diagnostic, a normalized task event, an imported provider annotation, or heuristic text parsing. Heuristic parsing requires an explicit confidence tier and a raw-output backlink; structured and heuristic origins stay distinct.

problem_severity.description: Finding severity, independent of source confidence.

confidence_tier.description: Confidence taxonomy shared with the causality matrix. Structured fields are full confidence; heuristic parses carry an explicit tier; imported provider mappings carry their mapping quality; unmapped is a first-class state, not an invisible gap.

freshness_state.description: Freshness/anchoring state of the run the finding came from. Stale and superseded states must remain visibly classified wherever the row is rendered.

rerun_authority.description: Authority the row has to rerun or inspect its originating task/session. Remote/imported origins inspect read-only and never offer a live local rerun; a gated rerun is surfaced as gated, not silently dropped.

output_channel_class.description: Owning output-channel class shared with the causality matrix. A real channel must carry a stable channel ref so open-owning-output stays available.

proof_currency.description: Currency of the certification proof that this row preserves its causal chain (distinct from the run's own freshness_state).

source.description: Stable identifiers binding the finding to the tool/run that produced it. Lineage is reconstructed from these refs, never inferred from freeform text. A heuristic parse keeps its raw_output_backlink_ref.

anchor.description: File/span anchor. Carries an opaque workspace-relative file ref plus one-based line/column numbers only — never an absolute path or raw source text. A present anchor lets jump-to-source resolve.

correlations.description: How the row is correlated to the rest of the surface: editor decoration, activity-center timeline entry, source task (the rerun/inspect handle), and owning output channel. A private bottom-panel truth model is not allowed; these refs join the existing surfaces.

evidence.description: The origin/confidence honesty invariants a row re-derives rather than trusting: structured/heuristic distinct, raw backlink on heuristic, confidence labelled, source/run lineage preserved, superseded state marked, imported overlay read-only, and whether the provenance mapping was downgraded.

allOf.description: Remote, pipeline, and imported origins must carry a provider ref so the read-only row can name its source.
